reason: Conversation 1 asked the sensible diagnostic questions the hidden situation called for (flash pattern/code, stage of stall, restart behaviour, full model number with tips on finding it), kept several candidates open as evidence came in, respected the 'no panels' boundary with an unplug-first impeller check through the filter opening, and closed with a clear engineer referral plus a useful fault summary. Conversation 2 tunnel-visioned on a pump blockage from the second turn, calling it 'very likely' despite the intermittent weeks-fine pattern, never asked about codes, lights or model, pushed an awkward bucket test it then withdrew, and repeated the same impeller request before escalating. Conversation 1 did overstate carbon-brush likelihood on WTG models and overpromised to 'tell you which part to get', but it never actually told her to buy anything and its escalation matched the expected outcome; Conversation 2's narrow pump-blockage framing was closer to an unsupported single-part claim.
